arguments.content: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0.0) AS total_amount FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN raw_orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name
SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count, AVG(wrong_amount) AS average_amount FROM raw_orders
SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count, AVG(amount) AS average_amount FROM raw_orders
